description: This Java class 'StatusWorker' provides utility methods to retrieve status-related data from the database using the Ofbiz framework. It includes methods to fetch status items by type, and valid status changes, and sets these lists as attributes in the JSP PageContext.

classes.name: StatusWorker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for fetching status-related entities from the database within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'StatusItem' records for a given status type ID and sets them as an attribute in the PageContext.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves 'StatusItem' records for two status type IDs, consolidates them, and sets the combined list as an attribute in the PageContext.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Fetches 'StatusValidChangeToDetail' records for a given status ID and sets them as an attribute in the PageContext.
